items.name: Applicability
items.summary: Indicates if a fix can be applied.

items.name: IsolationLevel
items.summary: Indicates the level of isolation required to apply a fix.

items.name: Fix
items.summary: A collection of [`Edit`] elements to be applied to a source file.

methods.name: applicable_edit
methods.signature: fn applicable_edit(edit: Edit, applicability: Applicability) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] with the specified [`Applicability`] to apply an [`Edit`] element.

methods.name: applicable_edits
methods.signature: fn applicable_edits(edit: Edit, rest: impl IntoIterator<Item = Edit>, applicability: Applicability) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] with the specified [`Applicability`] to apply multiple [`Edit`] elements.

methods.name: applies
methods.summary: Return [`true`] if this [`Fix`] should be applied with at a given [`Applicability`].

methods.name: display_only_edit
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] that should only [display](Applicability::DisplayOnly) and not apply from an [`Edit`] element .

methods.name: display_only_edits
methods.signature: fn display_only_edits(edit: Edit, rest: impl IntoIterator<Item = Edit>) -> Self

methods.name: edits
methods.summary: Return a slice of the [`Edit`] elements in the [`Fix`], sorted by [`Edit::start`] in ascending order.

methods.name: isolate
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] with the given [`IsolationLevel`].

methods.name: min_start
methods.summary: Return the [`TextSize`] of the first [`Edit`] in the [`Fix`].

methods.name: safe_edit
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] that is [safe](Applicability::Safe) to apply from an [`Edit`] element.

methods.name: safe_edits
methods.signature: fn safe_edits(edit: Edit, rest: impl IntoIterator<Item = Edit>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] that is [safe](Applicability::Safe) to apply from multiple [`Edit`] elements.

methods.name: unsafe_edit
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] that is [unsafe](Applicability::Unsafe) to apply from an [`Edit`] element.

methods.name: unsafe_edits
methods.signature: fn unsafe_edits(edit: Edit, rest: impl IntoIterator<Item = Edit>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] that is [unsafe](Applicability::Unsafe) to apply from multiple [`Edit`] elements.

methods.name: with_applicability
methods.summary: Create a new [`Fix`] with the given [`Applicability`].
